tools.name: search_frequencies
tools.description: Search KYMA369's public frequency library by keyword, title, Hz value, or wellness goal (e.g. sleep, calm, focus, energy, grounding). Returns matching frequency sets with play links.

tools.name: get_frequency
tools.description: Fetch one frequency set by UUID id or exact title. Returns details plus a KYMA app play link.

tools.name: list_popular
tools.description: List popular / high-priority frequency sets from the KYMA public catalog.

tools.name: get_play_link
tools.description: Build a tracked deep link to play a frequency set in the free KYMA369 web app.

tools.name: about_kyma
tools.description: Product card for KYMA369: the devices (KYMA T3, T3 Reset, C6) with current prices, the offer, the founder, the free app and key links. Call this before describing KYMA.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search Guides by Harold (Rife machines, PEMF devices, frequencies, history) and the public FAQ. Use for what a Rife machine is, prices, where to buy, comparisons, how it works, frequency lists or history. Returns titles, summaries and URLs.

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Search every public KYMA369 FAQ answer (https://kyma369.com/faq). Use before answering Rife machine, PEMF, price, return, setup or KYMA product questions. Returns the question, a short answer, and the canonical URL. Omit query to list the top FAQs. Use offset to page through the full bank.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: List Guides by Harold (https://kyma369.com/blog) by section: buying a Rife machine, how it works, frequencies, PEMF devices, history. The Rife guides are also at https://kyma369.com/rife.

tools.name: get_hz_page
tools.description: Return the canonical KYMA encyclopedia URL for a named Hz or hub (e.g. 432, 528, 7.83, 40, sleep-frequencies, solfeggio-frequencies). Use this instead of inventing Hz facts.

tools.name: compare_frequencies
tools.description: Look up a KYMA encyclopedia compare page (not the T3/C6 shop /compare). Examples: 432-vs-440, 528-vs-432, rife-vs-solfeggio, audio-vs-pemf.

tools.name: headphones_or_pemf
tools.description: Given a Hz value, say whether headphones can play the fundamental (~≥20 Hz) or a PEMF coil is required. Returns the checker URL.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_faq" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_frequencies" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
